visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black hoodie stands outdoors at night next to a Domino's delivery scooter; he holds several pizza boxes and a large bottle of Pepsi, smiling broadly at the camera. (2) Inside a brightly lit living room, the man and a woman in a red sweatshirt sit on a sofa, handing red envelopes to two daughters standing before them; the family members are smiling and talking. (3) The younger daughter is in her room, frantically pulling open a drawer and searching through papers and items; her facial expression is one of worry and confusion. (4) In the living room, the younger daughter approaches her older sister who is at a laptop; the older girl dismisses her with a shrug. (5) The scene shifts to the kitchen where the mother is shouting at the younger daughter while holding a phone; the father enters and places his hand on the mother's shoulder, trying to calm her down. (6) A dynamic transition occurs showing a close-up of a 'Volcano Pizza' with a tall dough ring in the center filled with white sauce; graphic zoom lines appear for emphasis. (7) The man takes a slice of pizza and dips it into the central sauce, then eats it with an exaggerated look of surprise and delight; sauce is visible on his mouth. (8) The whole family is gathered around a table filled with various pizzas and sides; they all lean in to look at the pizza with shocked and excited faces. (9) The man is shown dipping a bagel into the leftover white sauce and taking a large bite. (10) A dessert pizza topped with chocolate and Kit Kat bars is revealed in a box; the younger daughter takes a bite while the man points at the pizza and speaks to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced upbeat electronic BGM begins with a high-pitched energetic male greeting; the sound of a scooter engine is faintly audible in the background. (2) Vocal texture shifts to warm, conversational tones as multiple voices exchange New Year greetings; the BGM remains a consistent rhythmic bed. (3) A sudden 'shuffling' incidental noise as a drawer opens, followed by the younger girl's high-pitched, anxious questioning voice; BGM continues. (4) Vocal intensity rises as the mother's voice becomes authoritative and loud; the father's voice enters with a low-pitch, calming prosody to soothe the argument. (5) A sharp 'Whoosh' transition SFX triggers a shift to high-energy male narration; 'Wow' audience reaction SFX are inserted for comic effect. (6) Prominent 'Crunch' and 'Slurp' foley sounds as the man eats pizza; his voice is high-arousal and rhythmic, matching the fast beat of the music. (7) Teenage and child female voices express excitement with high-pitched exclamations; BGM remains dominant with synthesized percussion. (8) BGM swells in volume for the final celebratory narration; ends with a single questioning phrase from the child followed by a comedic stinger SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Conflict -> Solution -> Demonstration -> Social Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: Promoting Domino's new 'Volcano Pizza' and Kit Kat dessert pizza by showing them as a stress-relieving family meal during the Chinese New Year holiday, emphasizing the unique dipping sauce and variety of flavors.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of product name, close-up food reviews, and visible brand logos.
